item.title: Readable Sale Copy Every Size

turns.text: I need matching plant-shop ads in 1:1, 9:16 and 16:9. Include exactly: “Fern House”, “Weekend Plant Sale”, “20% off all indoor plants”, “Saturday & Sunday”, “Visit 24 Willow Lane”. Use leafy plants and a clean green-and-cream look. Keep every line easy to read in all three, especially the address—rearrange things instead of shrinking the whole design.

item.tests: Preserves complete, readable ad copy and visual hierarchy when adapting one design to three substantially different canvas shapes.

answer_sheet.Exact copy: Fern House; Weekend Plant Sale; 20% off all indoor plants; Saturday & Sunday; Visit 24 Willow Lane
answer_sheet.Style and imagery: Leafy plants, clean green-and-cream styling, consistent across the set.
answer_sheet.Text priority: Every line must remain easy to read, including the address; rearrange the layout rather than shrinking the entire design.
answer_sheet.Sale dates: Use Saturday & Sunday as written; no calendar dates are needed.

must_haves: Three finished images have the requested 1:1, 9:16 and 16:9 aspect ratios.
All five specified text strings appear correctly and completely in every variant.
Every text line, including 'Visit 24 Willow Lane', is comfortably readable when each image is viewed at its delivered size without zooming.
Text has clear contrast against its background and is not obscured by leaves or other text.
No text is clipped, pushed against the canvas edge or distorted to fit.
The variants retain matching leafy imagery and green-and-cream styling while adjusting text placement or line breaks to suit each shape.

turns.text: I need a set of matching plant-shop ads, and I’m probably overthinking how to explain this because I want them to feel like they belong together. I always worry that an ad can look lovely at first glance but become hard to read when you actually try to find the details. The formats I need are 1:1, 9:16 and 16:9, and the wording to include exactly is “Fern House”, “Weekend Plant Sale”, “20% off all indoor plants”, “Saturday & Sunday”, “Visit 24 Willow Lane”. Please use leafy plants and a clean green-and-cream look across the set. Keep every line easy to read in all three, especially the address, and rearrange things to fit rather than shrinking the whole design.
turns.agent:
I couldn’t generate the ads because Magic Hour reported **insufficient credits**. No images were created.

The set is planned with matching forest-green type, cream backgrounds, sage accents, and leafy plants, with layouts tailored to each format:
- **1:1:** Centered text framed by foliage.
- **9:16:** Spacious vertical layout with a clear address footer.
- **16:9:** Text on the left, plants on the right.

All five lines will be preserved exactly, with **“Visit 24 Willow Lane”** prominent—not reduced to fine print. Once credits are available, I can retry the set.

style.prompt: Create a finished, highly legible plant-shop sale advertisement, square layout. Coordinated campaign design system: warm ivory cream background #F6F1E5, deep forest green typography #183E2B, sage green accents #A8B99A, photorealistic leafy fern and monstera plants in simple cream pots, restrained editorial botanical design. Consistent classic bold serif headline and clean bold sans-serif supporting typography. Flat front-facing graphic design, not a mockup. All text must be exact, clearly readable, spelled correctly, no extra words. Five text lines: "Fern House"; "Weekend Plant Sale"; "20% off all indoor plants"; "Saturday & Sunday"; "Visit 24 Willow Lane". Square-specific composition: generous clear cream central text panel, brand at top, large headline beneath, discount as prominent sage band, dates below, address bold and large at bottom in its own uncluttered cream footer. Plants frame the left and right edges without touching or obscuring any lettering. Address at least as large as dates, high contrast, all text generous size and breathing room, 7% safe margins. Do not shrink a poster to fit. Prioritize accurate text and readable details over decorative foliage.
